/** @module */
export declare const brand: unique symbol;

export interface Link {
  readonly next?: Link;
}

/** Box documentation. */
export declare class Box<T> {
  /** Static description. */
  static build<T>(value: T): Box<T>;
  constructor(value: T);
  /** Value description. */
  value: T;
  get current(): T;
  set current(value: T);
  [brand]: "Box Link T";
}

/** Alias documentation. */
export type Select<T> = {
  [K in keyof T as K extends string ? K : never]: T[K] | Link;
};

/** Callable documentation. */
export declare const choose: {
  /** First overload. */
  (value: Link): Link;
  /** Second overload. */
  <T>(value: T, fallback: T): T;
  new (value: Link): Box<Link>;
  readonly marker: typeof brand;
};

declare function conditional<T>(value: T): T;
export { conditional as if };
export type { Box as TypeBox };

export declare namespace Nested {
  /** Nested description. */
  interface Value {
    readonly value: Link;
  }
}

export interface Shadow {
  first: Link;
  second<Link>(value: Link): Link;
  text: "Link";
}

export declare class Mixed {}
export interface Mixed {
  extra: string;
}
